title: Software, programming languages and translators: 8 questions
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 8 software and languages questions)

questions.q: Give two functions of an operating system.
questions.a: Any two: file management, process management, peripheral management, user management

questions.q: What does a defragmentation utility do?
questions.a: Rearranges the parts of files on a magnetic disk so each file is stored in one place, making access faster

questions.q: Why would someone use a compression utility?
questions.a: To make files smaller so they use less storage and send faster

questions.q: Explain the difference between a compiler and an interpreter.
questions.a: A compiler translates the whole program into machine code before it runs; an interpreter translates and runs it one line at a time

questions.q: Give one advantage of using an interpreter while writing a program.
questions.a: It stops at the line with the error so it is quick to find and fix; no need to recompile

questions.q: Give one reason a programmer might use a low-level language.
questions.a: Direct control of the hardware, or fast, memory-efficient code (e.g. for embedded systems)

questions.q: What translates assembly language into machine code?
Give one way software can be made more robust.
questions.a: For example: validating input, testing, code reviews, audit trails
